test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In January 2023, the Warehouse Development Regulation Authority (WDRA) signed a memorandum of understanding with _______________ of India to help farmers get low interest rate loans.
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **January 2023**, the **Warehouse Development Regulation Authority (WDRA)** signed a memorandum of understanding.
 
• This agreement was with the **State Bank of India (SBI)**.
 
• The purpose of this MoU is to help **farmers** get **low interest rate loans**.
 
• The initiative aims to strengthen the **agriculture sector** by providing easier access to credit.
 
• **State Bank of India** is the largest public sector bank in India.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the **financial inclusion** of various sectors in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bank of Baroda**__

 __
 
• **Bank of Baroda** is another major public sector bank in India.
 
• It was founded in **1908** and is headquartered in **Vadodara, Gujarat**.
 
 
 
• **Canara Bank**__
 __
 
• **Canara Bank** is one of the oldest public sector banks in India.
 
• It was established in **1906** and is headquartered in **Bengaluru, Karnataka**.
 
 
 
• **Union Bank of India**__
 
 
• **Union Bank of India** is a leading public sector bank in India.
 
• The bank was established in **1919** and is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
